column1: Simulate Phase 42A.8 cache behavior during replay.
Day T data → save as valid (localStorage) → simulate API failure → page retains Day T data
Day T+1 server data → must replace Day T cached data
- [ ] Cache save after successful data load
- [ ] Cache restore on page load before API call
- [ ] Successful API → cache replaced with new data
- [ ] Older cache CANNOT overwrite newer server data
- [ ] Symbol isolation: NIFTY cache ≠ BANKNIFTY cache
TRUE EMPTY STATE ONLY IF NO VALID DATA HAS EVER EXISTED
